scientific_integrity: Self-contained algebraic proof with executable finite checks; no claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: The general complete census assumes nilpotent core adjacency over characteristic two.
Other path/cycle sizes are only classified with respect to pure two-power periodicity, not all periods.
A closely relevant historical second-order cellular-automaton paper was accessible by abstract but not full text.
title: Pendant doubling of nilpotent Jordan chains and dyadic path–cycle clocks
